themes.name: Portal Default
themes.tagline: The theme a fresh install renders with.
themes.description: The product’s own stock theme: a white page, hairline rules, one slate-blue action colour, system type and no ornament. Not a Gallery theme and not a brand — the neutral ground a new deployment renders completely on before anyone chooses anything.

themes.name: Cosmic Answer
themes.tagline: Learn to ask better questions of an expanding universe.
themes.description: A memorable expression of 42: open inquiry, many possible paths, and evidence guiding learners toward useful answers.

themes.name: Learning Portal
themes.tagline: From curious beginner to capable AI practitioner.
themes.description: A warm, human education brand built around an open doorway, visible steps, and progress that never feels mysterious.

themes.name: Model Constellation
themes.tagline: Understand the whole AI landscape—not one vendor.
themes.description: A provider-neutral network where models, tools, agents, sources, and fact checks connect into durable learner evidence.

themes.name: Field Signal
themes.tagline: Practical bearings for a fast-changing field.
themes.description: A durable operational identity combining a field manual, a navigational beacon, and evidence-marked routes.

themes.name: Open Orbit
themes.tagline: Learning that stays open, current, and in motion.
themes.description: A visibly open review loop connecting research, teaching, practice, fact-checking, and community contribution.

themes.name: The Galactic Guide (Don't Panic)
themes.tagline: The Answer to AI, Agents, and Everything.
themes.description: A friendly, provider-neutral survival guide from your very first prompt to production multi-agent swarms. 13 paths, 92 modules, and always knowing where your context is.

themes.name: Quiet Lantern
themes.tagline: A field manual you can read in daylight.
themes.description: The first bundle produced by the Gallery generator: a light-polarity field manual -- square corners, heavy rules, stencilled capitals -- with every foreground derived from the surface it is printed on.

layouts.name: Compact
layouts.description: A denser composition: narrower measure, tighter spacing rhythm, smaller controls and radii, and a shorter type ramp. Fits more on screen and suits reference-heavy reading.

layouts.name: Standard
layouts.description: The default composition: balanced content width, comfortable spacing rhythm, and a moderate type ramp. Suits a reading-led site with cards and long-form modules.

layouts.name: Wide
layouts.description: An expansive composition: wide measure, generous spacing rhythm, larger controls and radii, and a taller type ramp. Suits large displays and presentation use.
